prompt: Tapping the heart on one product card in a category grid re-renders every card in the grid, even though ProductCard is wrapped in memo. Find out why memo isn't working and fix it.

truth.cause: ProductGrid passes onToggleSaved as an inline arrow (() => wishlist.toggle(product.id)), creating a new function for every card on every grid render, so memo's shallow prop comparison always fails when the wishlist context changes.
truth.summary: Pass the stable wishlist.toggle callback and let the card supply its own product id, so only the card whose isSaved changed re-renders.
